prerequisites: Node.js 18 and npm. CI builds on Node 18, and `package.json` asks for Node 18 or later. The README and `.nvmrc` still name Node 16.

steps.title: Install the dependencies
steps.text: CI installs with the `--legacy-peer-deps` flag. Without it, `npm ci` stops with an `ERESOLVE` peer dependency error.

steps.title: Set the API URL (optional)
steps.text: `npm start` reads `.env.development`, so the app calls the Greenstand dev APIs at `https://dev-k8s.treetracker.org` (for example, `REACT_APP_API_ROOT=https://dev-k8s.treetracker.org/api/admin`). To use a local admin API instead, put its URL in `.env.local`:

steps.title: Run the tests
steps.text: `CI=true` runs the tests once, as in CI. Without it, `npm test` starts in watch mode. At this commit, 102 tests pass and 6 are skipped. In one of two runs, `src/components/tests/verify.test.js` failed after 36 seconds; it passed when it ran again.

steps.title: Build the app
steps.text: The build goes to the `build/` folder.

steps.title: Start the app
steps.text: Open http://localhost:3001. The README says that the login details for the dev environment are pinned in the #admin_panel_chat channel on Slack.
